member.name: T:Fuxion.AspNet.ResponseExtensions
member.summary: Provides extension methods for converting and objects to ASP.NET Web API instances with support for various payload types including streams, byte arrays, strings, and complex objects.

remarks.para: This class enables seamless integration between Fuxion's Response pattern and ASP.NET Web API controllers by converting responses into appropriate HTTP action results with proper status codes, content types, and problem details formatting (RFC 7807).

item.description: Automatic status code mapping: Maps to appropriate HTTP status codes
Multiple payload types: Handles Stream, byte arrays, strings, and complex objects
RFC 7807 Problem Details: Generates standardized error responses with extensions
File download support: Specialized methods for file streams and byte arrays with content disposition
JSON serialization: Configurable System.Text.Json serialization with custom options
Exception handling: Optional exception details in error responses
Async/await support: Extension methods for both synchronous and asynchronous responses

para.strong: ErrorType to HTTP Status Code mapping:

item.description: 404 Not Found
403 Forbidden
400 Bad Request
409 Conflict
500 Internal Server Error
501 Not Implemented
503 Service Unavailable
408 Request Timeout

remarks.para: The class provides static configuration properties:

item.description: : Controls whether exception details are included in error responses (default: true)
: Custom JSON serialization options (default: null, uses default options)

example.strong: Full response serialization (includes all Response properties):

member.name: P:Fuxion.AspNet.ResponseExtensions.IncludeException
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether exception details should be included in error responses.
member.value: true to include exception details in error responses; otherwise, false. Default is true.

remarks.para: When set to true, exceptions are serialized using and included in the "exception" extension field of the problem details response.
Security consideration: In production environments, consider setting this to false to avoid exposing sensitive implementation details through stack traces and exception messages.

member.name: P:Fuxion.AspNet.ResponseExtensions.JsonSerializerOptions
member.summary: Gets or sets the to use for JSON serialization.
member.value: Custom JSON serializer options, or null to use default options. Default is null.

remarks.para: These options are used for serializing response payloads and problem details. The options are cloned before use to avoid modification issues.
If is true, an is automatically added to the converters when serializing error responses.

member.name: M:Fuxion.AspNet.ResponseExtensions.ToApiResultCore(Fuxion.IResponse,System.String,System.String,System.Boolean)
member.summary: Core implementation method that converts an to an .
member.param: The response to convert.
The content type for the response. If null, uses value from response extensions or defaults.
The file name for Content-Disposition header when returning files.
If true, serializes the entire Response object including metadata. If false, only serializes the payload or message.

remarks.para: This method handles the following scenarios:

item.description: Success with Stream payload: Returns 200 OK with StreamContent and Content-Disposition attachment header
Success with byte array payload: Returns 200 OK with ByteArrayContent and Content-Disposition attachment header
Success with string payload: Returns 200 OK with StringContent, optionally serializing the full Response object
Success with object payload: Returns 200 OK with JSON serialized payload or full Response
Success without payload: Returns 204 No Content or 200 OK with message
Error: Returns appropriate status code with RFC 7807 Problem Details

remarks.para: Problem Details structure: Error responses follow RFC 7807 format with:

item.description: type: RFC 9110 reference URL for the status code
status: HTTP status code (integer)
title: Human-readable summary
detail: Detailed error message from Response.Message
extensions: Additional data including payload and exception (if enabled)

member.name: M:Fuxion.AspNet.Factory.GetTypeFromStatusCode(System.Net.HttpStatusCode)
member.summary: Maps an HTTP status code to its corresponding RFC 9110 specification URL.
member.param: The HTTP status code to map.
member.returns: A string containing the RFC 9110 URL for the status code (e.g., "https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc9110.html#section-15.5.5" for 404).
member.exception: Thrown when the status code is not explicitly supported in the mapping.

remarks.para: This method provides comprehensive mapping for standard HTTP status codes defined in RFC 9110:

item.description: 1xx: Informational responses (Continue, Switching Protocols)
2xx: Successful responses (OK, Created, Accepted, No Content, etc.)
3xx: Redirection messages (Multiple Choices, Moved Permanently, etc.)
4xx: Client error responses (Bad Request, Unauthorized, Forbidden, Not Found, etc.)
5xx: Server error responses (Internal Server Error, Not Implemented, Service Unavailable, etc.)

remarks.para: The URLs point to the official HTTP Semantics specification (RFC 9110) hosted at httpwg.org.

member.name: T:System.Runtime.CompilerServices.ModuleInitializerAttribute
member.summary: Used to indicate to the compiler that a method should be called in its containing module's initializer.
member.remarks:
When one or more valid methods with this attribute are found in a compilation, the compiler will emit a module initializer which calls each of the attributed methods.
Certain requirements are imposed on any method targeted with this attribute: - The method must be `static`. - The method must be an ordinary member method, as opposed to a property accessor, constructor, local function, etc. - The method must be parameterless. - The method must return `void`. - The method must not be generic or be contained in a generic type. - The method's effective accessibility must be `internal` or `public`.
The specification for module initializers in the .NET runtime can be found here: https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/docs/design/specs/Ecma-335-Augments.md#module-initializer
